title: May Great Grace Fall Upon Us
lyrics_original: Lord we read in Thy Word,
How Thy people once were stirred
When Thy Spirit came and shook their meeting place
How our hearts long to know
Of that Grace that stirred them so
Hear our prayer, O Lord, as now we seek Thy face
May great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray
May great grace fall upon us, Lord, today
May Thy Word be preached with power,
Fill our need of Thee this hour,
And may great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray
Lord, today, as long ago,
We Thy people need Thee so
For Thy power alone can light the Gospel flame
Lord, be pleased to bless this place
With the Spirit of Thy Grace
Send Thy Gospel forth and glorify Thy Name
May great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray
May great grace fall upon us, Lord, today
May Thy Word be preached with power,
Fill our need of Thee this hour,
And may great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray

bible_verses.english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
Preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, we come to You today with hearts longing for Your presence and power. Just as You poured out Your Spirit upon the early believers, we ask that Your great grace would rest upon us in this moment. Fill our deepest needs, Lord, and let Your Word speak with life and clarity to our souls. Shake our hearts anew and empower us to walk faithfully in Your love today. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Looking back at the early church, we see how the Holy Spirit moved powerfully whenever God’s people gathered in prayer. This song echoes that same sacred longing, inviting us to step into God's presence with open hearts and humble expectation. As we draw near to His throne of grace today, we are reminded that the same God who filled their meeting place is ready to pour out His abundant grace on us now. Let us invite His Spirit to refresh our souls and empower us to live boldly for Christ.
